categories.name: Upscaling and super resolution
categories.description: Resize images with general resampling, anime outline reconstruction, pixel-art scaling, or temporal upscaling.

subcategories.name: General purpose
subcategories.description: Resize photos, video, games, and interfaces. Bilinear is soft and inexpensive, Bicubic offers adjustable smoothness and sharpness, and Lanczos favors sharp edges.

subcategories.name: Anime and line art
subcategories.description: Reconstruct outlines and flat colors in anime and visual novels. Choose denoising models for noisy content and a fixed scale that suits the target size.

subcategories.name: Pixel art
subcategories.description: Nearest preserves pixel blocks; xBR/xBRZ smooth outlines. Integer scales keep an even grid; flexible-size methods fit a window or display.

subcategories.name: Temporal reconstruction
subcategories.description: Reconstruct detail from consecutive captured frames for games and video. Motion is estimated from images; fast motion, occlusion, and UI edges can produce ghosting.

subcategories.name: Downscaling and resizing
subcategories.description: Reduce image resolution or fit a fixed-scale upscaled image to the final output size.

categories.name: Cleanup and restoration
categories.description: Reduce noise, banding, or line defects, usually before upscaling and sharpening.

subcategories.name: Denoising
subcategories.description: Reduce grain and compression noise. Start with low strength and increase for noisier content; stronger processing also smooths fine texture.

subcategories.name: Debanding
subcategories.description: Soften stepped gradients in skies and shadows; use threshold and range to control the amount.

subcategories.name: Line restoration
subcategories.description: Restore anime outlines or adjust line thickness, usually before upscaling.

categories.name: Anti-aliasing
categories.description: Smooth stair-step edges using the current frame or consecutive frames.

subcategories.name: Spatial
subcategories.description: Smooth outlines in the current image as a starting point for game anti-aliasing. Processing also softens some text and thin lines.

subcategories.name: Temporal
subcategories.description: Use frame history to process thin lines and diagonals. Experimental methods can produce ghosting at moving edges.

categories.name: Sharpening
categories.description: Enhance edges and local contrast to clarify soft images.

subcategories.name: General sharpening
subcategories.description: Usually apply one sharpener after resizing, starting at low strength. Stronger settings amplify noise and create halos at high-contrast edges.

categories.name: Frame generation and frame rate
categories.description: Frame generation adds intermediate images for display; limiting controls the base input rate. Set the base rate, duplicate detection, and idle redraw in Frame rate and refresh.

subcategories.name: Frame generation
subcategories.description: Choose one frame generator per group and start at 2x. Higher multipliers cost more processing; fast motion, occlusion, and game text can produce artifacts.

subcategories.name: Frame-rate control
subcategories.description: Cap the base rate of capture and processing; with frame generation, this is the input rate used to generate frames.

categories.name: Display styles
categories.description: Adjust color, brightness, textures, or retro display appearance to suit viewing preferences.

subcategories.name: CRT
subcategories.description: Simulate vintage screens with scanlines, masks, glow, or curvature, usually after resizing. The look is designed for SDR; HDR uses compatibility conversion.

subcategories.name: Image adjustment
subcategories.description: Adjust tone and color, starting with brightness and contrast one control at a time.

subcategories.name: AI image enhancement
subcategories.description: Reshape textures and detail style; start with one pass at low intensity to explore the look.

categories.name: Diagnostics
categories.description: Inspect motion direction and confidence to locate temporal-processing issues.

subcategories.name: Diagnostics
subcategories.description: Display motion and reliability as color maps for debugging optical flow and consecutive-frame processing.

categories.name: HDR components
categories.description: Set HDR/SDR conversion order. Compatibility pairs allow an SDR processing section, white-point mapping presents SDR content, and TrueHDR uses AI to reshape brightness and color. Enable Windows HDR on the relevant capture/output display.
